title: Understanding Dimensionality
text: To determine the dimensionality of the parameter vector in a regression model, consider the number of features used. Each unique genre can be a feature in the model.

title: One-Hot Encoding
text: When dealing with categorical variables like genre, one common approach is to use one-hot encoding. This means creating a binary variable for each category.
